purpose: Controlled prompt matrix and QA system for Lia brunette video, ComfyUI lab tests, Higgsfield finals, ElevenLabs voice, and later lipsync. Mara is reserved for the red-haired model.

identity_lock.fixed_prompt: Use the input image as the identity source. Preserve the same fictional adult brunette UGC model: oval face, warm light skin, natural freckles, brown eyes, thick dark eyebrows, straight natural nose, full pink lips, soft warm smile, shoulder-length wavy brown hair with subtle highlights, natural skin texture, white or cream outfit, clean bright room lighting.
identity_lock.negative_prompt: different person, red hair, changed face, changed eyes, changed eyebrows, changed nose, changed lips, changed smile, changed hair, changed age, plastic skin, beauty filter, warped mouth, distorted teeth, blurry face, face flicker, cartoon, anime, fake logo, text, watermark, scene change, background transformation

batch_rules.do_not_generate_thousands_until: At least one 12-video batch scores identity>=4, artifacts>=4, and ugc_use>=4 on the same route.
batch_rules.first_batch_recipe: 4 same-room closeups, 4 outfit-still variations, 4 location-still variations. No major location and wardrobe change inside the same video prompt.

routes.label: ComfyUI LTX 2.3
routes.use_for: fast local identity and motion validation before paid final renders
routes.avoid: major location change, wide shots, extra objects, strong hand gestures

routes.label: ComfyUI Wan2.2 TI2V 5B
routes.use_for: first serious Mara UGC image-to-video tests with identity locked and controllable cost/time
routes.avoid: wide shots, walking, new locations, visible speech, and large hand motion until identity scores 4/5

routes.label: ComfyUI Wan2.2 I2V A14B FP8
routes.use_for: higher quality final identity/motion tests after Wan 5B proves the prompt direction
routes.avoid: running large batches before one 5B smoke clip passes QA

routes.label: Higgsfield Seedance 2.0
routes.use_for: identity-preserving reference-driven tests and motion reference route
routes.avoid: audio inside first render unless specifically testing audio behavior

routes.label: Higgsfield Kling 3.0
routes.use_for: cinematic motion and premium shots after still approval

routes.label: Higgsfield Veo 3.1 Lite
routes.use_for: budget batch clips after direction is clear

routes.use_for: controlled audio/lipsync experiments only after silent route works
routes.avoid: treating Wan as the default best model for all UGC

hooks.label: Skincare steps
hooks.text: Tu rutina de 10 pasos no era skincare. Era marketing.

hooks.label: Product seen
hooks.text: Esto parece simple, pero cambia como se ve el producto en camara.

hooks.label: Not testimonial
hooks.text: No voy a fingir que esto es una review real. Te muestro como se usaria.

hooks.label: One detail
hooks.text: Antes de comprar algo asi, miraria este detalle.

hooks.label: Less polished
hooks.text: Lo raro es que mientras menos producido se ve, mas real se siente.

hooks.label: Found better
hooks.text: Creo que encontre una forma mas limpia de mostrar este producto.

spoken_texts.label: Skincare safe 15s
spoken_texts.text: Tu rutina no necesita sonar complicada para verse bien. Mira la textura, la luz y como queda en piel. Menos pasos, mas claridad. Si quieres que tu producto se vea asi, pide una demo.

spoken_texts.label: UGC disclosure 15s
spoken_texts.text: Esto es una demostracion visual, no un testimonio real. La idea es mostrar el producto con claridad, sin prometer resultados que nadie comprobo. Asi se ve una pieza segura para redes.

spoken_texts.label: Fashion lifestyle 15s
spoken_texts.text: A veces el producto no necesita una sesion enorme. Necesita una toma limpia, buen movimiento y una razon clara para mirarlo. Esta es una version simple para probar estilo.

spoken_texts.label: Client offer 20s
spoken_texts.text: Si tu tienda publica productos pero las fotos no venden la experiencia, puedes probar creativos con modelo IA. Primero validamos el estilo, despues hacemos las versiones finales para redes y anuncios.

spoken_texts.label: Storytime soft 20s
spoken_texts.text: Anoche casi borre este video. Me vi en la pantalla y pense que estaba intentando gustarle a todos. Respire, no corregi nada, y entendi algo: a veces encontrarte empieza cuando dejas de editarte.

prompt_templates.ltx_i2v_motion_only: {identity_lock} Animate the existing close-up selfie only. Keep the same room, same lighting, same outfit and same camera framing. Motion: {motion}. Face must remain sharp, recognizable and stable. Preserve eyes, nose, lips, smile, jawline, hair and skin texture. No talking, no walking, no beach, no location change, no new outfit, no hand gesture, no camera zoom.
prompt_templates.wan22_ti2v_identity_motion: {identity_lock} Use the start image as the exact first frame and identity source. Create a silent vertical 9:16 ultra-realistic UGC selfie video. Visual style: {visual_style}. Setting lock: {setting}. Outfit lock: {outfit}. Motion: {motion}. Delivery energy: {tone}. Keep the face large, sharp and recognizable for the whole clip. Preserve eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, smile, jawline, hair, skin texture, outfit, room and lighting. No talking, no lip articulation, no hand gesture, no walking, no scene change, no new outfit, no text, no subtitles, no watermark, no logo.
prompt_templates.positive: {identity_lock} Create a vertical 9:16 ultra-realistic UGC video test. Visual style: {visual_style}. Setting: {setting}. Outfit: {outfit}. Motion: {motion}. Tone: {tone}. Hook line for first two seconds: "{hook}". Spoken text to support later ElevenLabs and lipsync: "{spoken_text}". Keep the face large and stable, natural skin texture, realistic eyes, realistic mouth, stable teeth, controlled hands, no scene change unless explicitly requested. This is an internal test frame/video for ONIA; do not add text, subtitles, watermarks, logos or fake product labels.
prompt_templates.negative: {negative_prompt}. Also avoid: wide shot before identity is stable, strong hand waving, product deformation, fake testimonial cues, medical claims, guaranteed results, visible third-party brands, copied creator performance.
prompt_templates.elevenlabs_direction: Spanish LATAM, young adult woman, natural UGC delivery, {tone}. Pace should fit {duration_seconds}s. Do not sound like a TV announcer. Leave tiny pauses after the hook and before CTA.

criteria.label: Identity
criteria.fail_if: Mara looks like another person, age changes, mouth/teeth drift, or hair/face changes.

criteria.label: Motion
criteria.fail_if: Motion is stiff, uncanny, broken walking, or hands dominate the shot.

criteria.label: Artifacts
criteria.fail_if: Face flicker, warped mouth, extra fingers, text artifacts, logo artifacts, or scene glitch.

criteria.label: UGC Use
criteria.fail_if: It does not feel native, believable, useful, or product-ready.

criteria.label: Claim Safety
criteria.fail_if: It implies a fake testimonial, fake result, medical claim, guarantee, or unauthorized brand.

criteria.label: Format
criteria.fail_if: Wrong aspect, too low quality, unreadable visuals, or unusable framing.

lipsync_route.preferred: Generate silent visual first, generate exact ElevenLabs audio second, apply dedicated lipsync third, then STT diff against spoken_text.
tools: Wan InfiniteTalk local pending visual QA
lipsync_route.do_not: Do not trust a general video model to preserve a word-perfect script.

approval_rules.comfyui_lab_generation: allowed after Pod is intentionally running and cost/time is accepted
